close_failure_witness.injection: Owned TemporaryFile closes its real descriptor, then raises OSError; real child sleeps after flushing stdout.

review_findings: Complete UTF-8 bytes and EOF remain available after slow reader startup across multiple polling slices.
Temporary stdin descriptor uses public APIs; private/unlinked POSIX input is absent from argv and closed on success, spawn failure, timeout, cancellation and staged deadline expiry.
OSError during owned descriptor closure records a failed cleanup envelope and still executes descendant observation stop, termination, reaping and output draining.
Input staging is included in the original budget; staging cannot restart an expired deadline.
No private CPython communicate/input-offset state is read or modified.
limits: Independent runtime evidence is macOS/arm64/Python3.11; cross-platform CI remains root integration work.
cleanup_verified remains false under the injected close error even though this witness reaped its child; no universal cleanup or sandbox containment claim.
Staging uses an owned temporary descriptor, not a stdin pipe; consumers that require pipe-specific seekability semantics are outside the documented text-delivery contract.
Existing scientific native, GUI and dependency receipts are retained and were not rerun.
